title: Daikon Risotto
description: A Japanese-inspired risotto dish featuring daikon and mild Italian flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the grated daikon and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Italian risotto and stir to combine with daikon.
Add 2 cups of vegetable broth to the skillet, and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding broth and stirring until the risotto is cooked and creamy, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and season with mild Italian seasoning.
Serve the daikon risotto hot, garnished with additional daikon if desired.
